name: Forward-mapping KDE with Dynamic Bandwidth
aliases: Density Estimation of Continuous Indexed Points
definition: Computes the density field of continuous indexed points using adapted kernel density estimation (KDE) with dynamic bandwidth to preserve high-density regions and smooth low-density regions.
summary: Forward-mapping KDE with Dynamic Bandwidth computes density fields by mapping points to the image plane and using variable bandwidths to preserve thin structures while smoothing low-density areas.
